questions.question:
Which the following of statements is/are correct?

1) The Peninsular region of India does not have any well-defined cold weather season.

2) By the end of December (that is, by 22 December), the Sun shines vertically over the Tropic of Capricorn in the Southern Hemisphere.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Both statements are correct**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Statement 1: The Peninsular region of India does not have any well-defined cold weather season.

 
 
• ✅This statement is **Correct**

 
 
• The **Peninsular region of India** (which includes states like Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, and Maharashtra) is surrounded by large water bodies like the **Arabian Sea, Bay of Bengal, and Indian Ocean**.
 
• This surrounding water **moderates** the climate, preventing extreme temperature variations.
 
• As a result, winters are **not severe**, and there is **no well-defined cold season** like in North India, where temperatures drop significantly in winter.
 
• In contrast, regions like **Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, and Uttar Pradesh** experience **distinct winter months (December–February)** due to cold winds from the Himalayas.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Statement 2: By the end of December (that is, by 22 December), the Sun shines vertically over the Tropic of Capricorn in the Southern Hemisphere.**
 
 
• ✅**This statement is ****Correct**
 
 
• **December 21 or 22** marks the **Winter Solstice**, which is the shortest day in the Northern Hemisphere and the longest day in the Southern Hemisphere.
 
• On this date, the Sun **is directly overhead at noon** over the **Tropic of Capricorn (23.5° South latitude)**.
 
• This happens because of the **tilt of Earth's axis (23.5°) and its revolution around the Sun**.
 
• As a result:
 
 
• The **Southern Hemisphere experiences summer**, and countries like Australia, South Africa, and Argentina have their hottest months.
 
• The **Northern Hemisphere experiences winter**, with shorter daylight hours and colder temperatures.

questions.question: Which of the below mentioned elements is NOT a way to finance the government deficits?

options.text: Borrowings from domestic and international sources

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Non-tax revenues**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Non-tax revenues,** such as income from public sector enterprises, fines, or licens**es, are typically considered as revenue sources, but t**hey are not usually a primary method for financing government deficits. **
 
• A **government deficit occurs** when a government spends more money than it receives in revenue.
 
• This deficit can i**ndicate how well a country's economy is doing financially. **
 
• **Types of government deficits**
 
 
• **Budget deficit:** The total amount by which a government's spending exceeds its revenue in a given year 
 
• **Revenue deficit:** When a government spends more on revenue than it receives in revenue 
 
• **Primary deficit:** The difference between a government's total expenses and its total revenue, excluding interest payments ​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Higher taxation**:

 
 
• When the **government increases taxe**s, it boosts its revenue.
 
• This can help reduce or eliminate a deficit, but it's more of a preventive measure (increasing revenue) than a method of financing an existing deficit.
 
 
 
• **Borrowings from domestic and international sources**:
 
 
• This is a **direct method of financing deficits.**
 
• Governments **often issue bonds, borrow from international institutions like the World Bank** or IMF, or obtain loans from domestic banks to raise funds and cover deficits.
 
 
 
• **Deficit financing**:
 
 
• This involves the **government borrowing from its central bank** or printing money to cover the deficit.
 
• This **increases the money supply **and can lead to inflation if done excessively.
 
• It's a common method for financing deficits, especially in situations where borrowing from external sources is not viable.

questions.question: In the context of cell organelles, a centriole is:

options.text: a stack of small flat sacs formed by membranes inside the cell's cytoplasm
a heterogeneous family of organelles found ubiquitously in plant cells
a paired barrel-shaped organelle located in the cytoplasm of animal cells near the nuclear envelope
a membrane-bound cell organelle that contains digestive enzymes

questions.solution:
The correct answer is a __**paired barrel-shaped organelle located in the cytoplasm of animal cells near the nuclear envelope**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A centriole is a** barrel-shaped organelle found in animal cells, **
 
• **It p**rimarily responsible for **organizing microtubu**les and playing a crucial role in cell division by forming the poles of the mitotic spindle
 
• It is typically located near the** nucleus within a structure called the centrosome. **
 
• **It is **Composed of **nine sets of microtubule triplets** arranged in a cylindrical pattern. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In the context of **cell biology, an "organelle" r**efers to a specialized structure within a cell that performs a specific function, essentially acting like a tiny organ within the cell, with examples including the nucleus (which stores DNA), mitochondria (which produce energy), and the endoplasmic reticulum (involved in protein synthesis). 
 
• Each **organelle has a dedicated task to contribute to th**e overall function of the cell, similar to how organs in a body have specific roles. 
 
• **Examples of organelles:**
 
 
• **Nucleus:** Stores genetic material (DNA) and controls cellular activities. 
 
• **Mitochondria: "**Powerhouse of the cell," produces energy in the form of ATP. 
 
• **Endoplasmic reticulum (ER)**: A network of membranes involved in protein synthesis and lipid production. 
 
• **Golgi apparatus**: Modifies and packages proteins for transport within the cell. 
 
• **Lysosomes**: Contain enzymes to break down waste materials. 
 
• **Ribosomes: **Small structures responsible for protein synthesis.

questions.question: In acetylene (C₂H₂), hybridzation of carbon atoms is:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**sp**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In acetylene (C2H2),** the hybridization of carbon atoms is sp. **
 
• In acetylene, the carbon atoms are connected by a **triple bond**, consisting of **one sigma bond** and **two pi bonds**.
 
• To form the linear structure of acetylene and accommodate the triple bond, each carbon atom undergoes **sp hybridization**.
 
• The sp hybridization involves mixing one s orbital and one p orbital, leaving two unhybridized p orbitals that form the two pi bonds.
 
• The bond angle in sp hybridization is **180°**, giving acetylene its linear shape.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hybridizatio**n is the process of combining carbon atom's atomic orbitals to form new hybrid orbitals.
 
• These hybrid orbitals have** different shapes and energies than the original orbitals.** 
 
• **Benefits of hybridization**
 
 
• Hybridization allows carbon to form strong sigma bonds, which contributes to the structural integrity of organic compounds. 
 
• Hybridization gives carbon the flexibility to form a variety of geometries and chemical and physical properties.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Mr. Prakash writes short stories.

options.text: Short stories were written by Mr. Prakash.
Short stories are being written by Mr. Prakash.
Short stories have been written by Mr. Prakash.
Short stories are written by Mr. Prakash.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Mr. Prakash writes short stories."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "short stories" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "writes" to "are written" (present simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "Mr. Prakash."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Short stories are written by Mr. Prakash."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Short stories were written by Mr. Prakash." – Incorrect tense (past simple passive).
 
• **Option 2: **"Short stories are being written by Mr. Prakash." – Incorrect tense (present continuous passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"Short stories have been written by Mr. Prakash." – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

The principal said that he would hold a meeting the next day.

options.text: “Tomorrow, I will hold a meeting,” says the principal.
“A meeting will be held by me,” said the principal.
“I will be holding a meeting tomorrow,” the principal said.
“I will hold a meeting tomorrow,” said the principal.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The principal said that he would hold a meeting the next day.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"that he would hold a meeting" becomes "I will hold a meeting"**
 
 
• Pronoun "he" is changed to "I" to match direct speech.
 
• Verb "would" is changed to "will" to match the future tense in direct speech.
 
 
 
• **"the next day" becomes "tomorrow"**
 
 
• Time expression "the next day" is converted to "tomorrow" for direct speech.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "said that"
 
• Converted to: "said", maintaining the reporting structure.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "I" and ends with a period ".".
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, starting with a lowercase letter after the comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"“I will hold a meeting tomorrow,” said the principal."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Tomorrow, I will hold a meeting," says the principal. 

 
 
• Uses present tense "says" instead of past tense "said".
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "A meeting will be held by me," said the principal. 
 
 
• Changes the active voice to passive voice, which is not a direct speech conversion.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "I will be holding a meeting tomorrow," the principal said. 
 
 
• Uses continuous future tense "will be holding" instead of simple future tense "will hold".
